introHtml: Paper plastic hand fans combine the lightweight feel of paper with the durability of a plastic handle, making them ideal for outdoor events, parades, and trade shows. The paper surface accepts full-color printing with crisp logos and messaging, while the plastic stem ensures longevity. Whether you need a budget-friendly giveaway for a summer festival or a branded fan for a sports stadium, these fans keep your audience cool and your brand visible. Choose from custom shapes and sizes to match your campaign.
